    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
    def select_batch(self, question, closed, state):
        W = question.max_parallelism
        roots = question.legal_roots()
        if roots:
            return roots[:W]
        by_branch = {}
        for o in sorted(question.observed().values(), key=lambda o: o.seq):
            by_branch.setdefault(o.branch, []).append(o)
        ranked = []
        for cell in question.legal_actions():
            hist = by_branch.get(question.meta(cell).branch, [])
            s = [o.score for o in hist if o.valid and o.score is not None]
            slope = (s[-1] - s[0]) / len(s) if len(s) > 1 else (s[-1] if s else float("-inf"))
            ranked.append((slope, -question.meta(cell).branch, cell))
        ranked.sort(reverse=True)
        return [c for _, _, c in ranked[:W]]
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
